I'll update the memory with the completed csp007 run results and commit.

## Project Overview
Building a financial decision support system (ChronoSentiment/Coralys) with portfolio replay experiments comparing P.E.2 (control) vs P.E.3/Coralys v0 arms. The system includes a Rust backend, Next.js portal, and historical experiment archives.

## Completed Work

**Domain & Testing (Reminders 1, 14)**
- 113 tests passing (107 → 113, 6 new P.E.3-H tests)

**API & Portal (Reminders 2–9)**
- POST /api/v0/portfolio/recommendations built with API adapter + route in main.rs
- Next.js proxy + /portfolio page + Nav link
- TypeScript: 0 errors throughout
- v0.2: GET /api/v0/decisions/current — backend serves certified decisions
- v0.2: POST body simplified (no decisions[] in body); /portfolio page sends only UserProfile + PortfolioContext

**P.E.2 & P.E.3 Archives (Reminders 10–18)**
- P.E.2 archive frozen at historical_runs/pe2_control_2026-08-16/ (IMMUTABLE)
- P.E.3 archive IMMUTABLE at historical_runs/pe3_coralys_v0_2026-08-16/
- observatory_historical_pe3.rs — replay_historical_pe3() implemented, registered in mod.rs
- csp006_p_replay_pe3 binary builds clean; result=PASS, 7 decisions, 7 eligible, 5 TARGET, 2 HORIZON
- Portal /replay: P.E.3 (current) + P.E.2 (archived control) side-by-side, sessions label fixed
- PE3Ledger type added to lib/data.ts; TypeScript 0 errors
- P.E.3 population confirmed complete (7 = full RESEARCH_UNIVERSE)

**Portfolio Replay v0.1 (Reminders 19–28)**
- Stop-loss diagnosis: STOP_EXIT_AUTHORIZED=false intentional in P.E.3-B; first_exit_with_optional_stop() ready
- portfolio_replay_v0.rs module defined: PortfolioState, PortfolioPosition, PortfolioEvent, PortfolioReplayLedger types
- run_portfolio_replay() implemented: ₹5,000 initial capital, same P.E.2 period, two independent portfolios
- P.E.2 arm: seal_execution_intent() + first_exit() (no stop)
- Coralys arm: seal_coralys_execution_intent() + first_exit_with_optional_stop(stop_authorized=true)
- Capital allocation: equal split across eligible recommendations, skip if already holding instrument
- Cash recycling: realized cash from closed positions redeployed to later recommendations
- Comparison report: total return, realized P&L, unrealized P&L, max drawdown, TARGET/STOP/HORIZON counts, avg hold
- csp007_portfolio_replay binary builds and runs clean (exit code 0, 0.88s)
- Archive at historical_runs/portfolio_comparison_pe2_vs_pe3_2026-08-16/ (IMMUTABLE)

**Confirmed Results (n=7, exploratory):**
- P.E.2 arm: +1.18% | TARGET=3 STOP=0 HORIZON=4 | avg_hold=15.0 sessions | max_dd=1.51%
- Coralys v0 arm: +0.89% | TARGET=4 STOP=2 HORIZON=1 | avg_hold=4.7 sessions | max_dd=0.61%

**Evidence & Product Tracks (Reminders 29–30)**
- CS-P-007 (Evidence Track A): consumes frozen P.E.2 + P.E.3 ledgers, paired differences, descriptive stats, labeled exploratory n=7
- Portfolio v0.3 (Product Track): ranked weekly action list with drill-down (priority, action, INR, target%, risk%, rationale)

**Git Commit (current)**
- `git add -A && git commit` in progress for Portfolio Replay v0.1 milestone

## Key Technical Decisions

- Two-arm portfolio replay: P.E.2 (fixed +5% target, no stop) vs Coralys v0 (ATR/TMV target + enforced risk_boundary stop)
- Same C3-002 decisions, same market data, same period — divergence measures product effect
- Equal capital allocation across eligible instruments; cash recycled on close
- STOP_EXIT_AUTHORIZED=false in P.E.3-B was intentional; stop enforcement only in Portfolio Replay v0.1 via first_exit_with_optional_stop()
- All experiment archives are IMMUTABLE after initial run
- Exploratory framing: n=7, not a statistical strategy backtest
- Validation ladder: Stage 1 (7 instruments, historical) → Stage 2 (expanded universe) → Stage 3 (forward testing); frozen models throughout

## Relevant Files & Code

**`adapters/chronosentiment/src/decision_support/portfolio_replay_v0.rs`**
- Structural corruption fix applied: comparison report construction code moved outside `for plan in &plans` loop
- Binary builds clean (exit code 0, dev profile, 0.88s)

**Key constants referenced:**
- `PORTFOLIO_REPLAY_PATH_KIND`, `PORTFOLIO_REPLAY_EXPERIMENT_ID`, `PORTFOLIO_REPLAY_REQUESTED_CLOCK`
- `INITIAL_CAPITAL_INR`, `CORALYS_EXEC_ARTIFACT_HASH`, `RESEARCH_DISCOVERY_TWO_ARTIFACT_HASH`
- `MAXIMUM_HOLD_SESSIONS`, `PE2_ARM_CONTRACT`, `CORALYS_ARM_CONTRACT`

**Key functions:**
- `seal_execution_intent()` — P.E.2 arm intent sealing
- `seal_coralys_execution_intent()` — Coralys arm intent sealing (returns CoralysExecutionResult::Intent or ::Invalid)
- `first_exit()` — P.E.2 exit (no stop)
- `first_exit_with_optional_stop(stop_authorized=true)` — Coralys exit with stop enforcement
- `build_arm_summary()` — builds PortfolioArmSummary from PortfolioState + final_marks
- `PortfolioState::close_position()`, `::total_value_inr()`, `::update_drawdown()`

## Current Status

csp007_portfolio_replay ran clean (exit code 0). Results confirmed:
- P.E.2: +1.18%, TARGET=3, STOP=0, HORIZON=4, avg_hold=15.0, max_dd=1.51%
- Coralys v0: +0.89%, TARGET=4, STOP=2, HORIZON=1, avg_hold=4.7, max_dd=0.61%

Git commit in progress for Portfolio Replay v0.1 milestone. All reminders 1–30 completed.
